fields.name: congenitalAbsenceUterus
fields.label: Congenital absence of uterus (MRKH syndrome / Mullerian agenesis)

fields.name: surgicalAbsenceUterus
fields.label: Surgical absence of uterus (hysterectomy for cancer, hemorrhage, fibroids)

fields.name: ashermansSyndrome
fields.label: Severe Asherman syndrome — failed hysteroscopic treatment

fields.name: uterineMalformation
fields.label: Severe uterine malformation incompatible with pregnancy (unicornuate, bicornuate, septate with failed correction)

fields.name: recurrentImplantationFailure
fields.label: Recurrent implantation failure (3+ failed IVF transfers with euploid embryos)

fields.name: recurrentPregnancyLoss
fields.label: Recurrent pregnancy loss with suspected uterine factor

fields.name: medicalContraindication
fields.label: Medical contraindication to pregnancy (cardiac, pulmonary, renal, oncologic)

fields.name: carrierScreeningComplete
fields.label: Carrier medical and psychological screening complete (ASRM guidelines)

fields.name: legalAgreementComplete
fields.label: Legal agreement between intended parents and carrier complete

fields.text: ASRM Carrier Screening Requirements. Medical: physical exam, PAP, STI screening, uterine evaluation, genetic carrier screening, drug/alcohol screening. Psychological: evaluation by mental health professional experienced in third-party reproduction. Legal: independent legal counsel for both parties
